integrity: All inequalities and quantifiers are proved analytically; the accompanying standard-library checker verifies finite rational perturbations and representative asymptotics, not an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact in the stated leading-order one-dimensional slow-driving functional, not in the full finite-speed master equation; isolated equilibrium crossing with continuous positive friction, positive budget, finite-duration absolutely continuous controls; independent validation not performed.
title: Equilibrium-crossing nonattainment in housekeeping-budget thermodynamic control
